academicYear: Current official Course List and four-year curriculum page; reviewed on 2026-08-24
note: The current official Department of Psychology Courses page states that it lists all Psychology Major Courses and Faculty Package Courses. Its 70,599-byte HTML snapshot had SHA-256 06d483f0bbdd3940545a4a1166ec04c3e582e57b82263012aad78230f06cd755 and contains 55 unique Psychology Major code-title rows plus 23 Faculty Package rows. PSYC1000 and PSYC1630 appear in both tables, producing 76 unique Programme-local codes. The Major table title Positive Communication for Healthy Relationships is retained for PSYC1630; the Faculty Package table shortens it to Communication for Healthy Relationship, and the difference is recorded rather than silently creating a duplicate. The same page publishes a 123-unit four-year curriculum with 55 Major units and separate double-major rules effective from 2022-23, but it does not publish per-course units or the required/elective membership of the 55 Major rows. The linked public Student Handbook browser requires a verification code and did not provide a code-title-unit scheme during review. Therefore every course keeps credits=0 as unknown, roles are limited to the two explicit page tables, and the complete 76-code scope is browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage.
